registration_boundary: Registered after the natural DRS WCD dev gate was known but before any horizon-stress report was produced. The first-128 paired prefix is deterministic and not selected by performance, validity, length, slack, or WCD outcome. This remains a descriptive replay diagnostic, not a confirmatory population experiment.

prerequisites.reason: The immutable closure supersedes the unavailable legacy suite-v2/v3 collector files and hash-binds all primary DRS gates and summaries.

selection.reason: Bound wall time while retaining a deterministic paired prefix fixed before the stress report.

source.note: The complete 400-record source artifact is verified before selecting its first 128 paired IDs. Invalid, truncated, or non-EOS selected rows remain visible and are never dropped.

audit.path: Replay each stored selected token plus EOS through the same exact byte-level-BPE transition and constructive completion oracle under every frozen counterfactual hard horizon.
audit.first_failure: Record the first token rejected by bounded certification, whether the corresponding unbounded transition is locally live, the remaining budget, and any concrete witness distance.
audit.horizon_choice: The original registered 64/128/192/256 grid is preserved exactly; every horizon is reported and none is selected after observing outcomes.

report: all 128 paired selected records including invalid or truncated source rows
planner false rejection on in-horizon accepting paths
source, manifest, closure, tokenizer, config, and implementation hashes
claim_boundary: This deterministic first-128 replay measures where already generated B/W paths encounter finite-horizon pressure. It can support bounded-versus-local mechanism claims only. It cannot show that WCD improves on BF/WF, estimate fresh-generation quality, or justify post-hoc sample selection.
